findings.violated_requirement: Installed speckit-plan Phase 1 step 3 requires quickstart.md: a runnable validation guide with prerequisites, setup commands, test/run commands, and expected outcomes.
findings.observed_deficiency: The required current quickstart.md file does not exist. The plan links to it, but no current guide supplies runnable end-to-end validation scenarios. A controlled-history copy is not the required feature deliverable.
findings.exact_correction: Restore specs/802-normalize-text/quickstart.md as a substantive validation guide with prerequisites, setup and proposed implementation-time test/run commands, exact expected normalization outputs including empty and ASCII-space/tab-only input, error status/stderr/empty-stdout checks, input preservation and repeatability checks, and links to the CLI contract and data model. Preserve all nine accepted policies and reviewed design decisions; distinguish proposed validation from executed implementation checks and do not include implementation bodies or complete test suites.
